technology_name: Smart Rainwater Sampling System: Automated Time-Integrated Sampler
institution: KSCSTE- Centre for Water Resources Development and Management (CWRDM)
problem_solved: Traditional rainwater sampling relies on daily or monthly composites, failing to capture short-term variations and risking cross-contamination between intervals.
description: An automated, low-cost rainwater sampling system designed to capture the high-resolution spatial and temporal variability of rainfall. The system collects rainwater through a funnel and automatically pumps it into separate sample bottles at user-defined intervals (e.g., hourly). Constructed from inert materials to eliminate chemical contamination, the lightweight and weatherproof device features automatic shut-off when rainfall ceases, optimized energy efficiency for field applications, and remote monitoring compatibility.
applications:
• High-resolution sequential data gathering for detailed hydrological modeling and climate studies

• Real-time monitoring of environmental pollution dynamics and acid rain trends by research agencies

• Scalable deployment in remote networks with limited existing infrastructure by environmental bodies

• Integration into agricultural planning systems requiring precise local precipitation records
